subject: Pilot top-up + loyalty bundle request — Adeptiva Labs
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@adeptiva.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@adeptiva.com>, procurement@adeptiva.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot top-up + loyalty bundle request — Adeptiva Labs

Hi Lena / Tom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Adeptiva is exactly the kind of pilot we want to support. A quick ask: the data science team needs an extra 250k token credits to finish a second set of evals and they asked whether we can offer a short extension on the 60-day trial window while they complete integration.

We discussed a possible loyalty bundle (one-time top-up of credits + a 12-month discount tied to a 12-month commitment) on the call. The customer is asking if we can make an exception to our standard trial/top-up rules for strategic pilots in healthcare. They are still evaluating two additional use cases and said a small committed contract next quarter is likely if the follow-up evals look good.

Attached: initial SOW and a pricing sketch.

Proposed ask for approval:
- Pilot top-up: 250,000 token credits (applied to trial account)
- Loyalty discount: 10% off list for 12 months if they convert to a $120k ARR commit within 90 days of pilot close

Business rationale:
- High strategic fit (Adeptiva is integrated with three of our reference partners)
- Potential ARR $120k+ in Q3 if pilots convert
- Competitive: they are evaluating two other vendors and price signal helps keep us in the running

Requesting fast-track approval from Revenue Ops / Execs to make the customer offer today.

Thanks — I can jump on a short call if you want to review the numbers.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up + loyalty bundle request — Adeptiva Labs

Rishi — thanks for the summary. A few quick questions before I take this to the credit committee:

1) What is the expected conversion probability (low/med/high) and any firm signals from the buyer team?
2) Do we have a signed NDA in place and are there any security/compliance blockers (they're in healthcare)?
3) Could you outline the net dollar impact at various outcomes (convert / no-convert)?

If this looks like >60% chance with a firm commit signal, I'm comfortable recommending an exception on the credits. For the loyalty discount I want to understand if we can gate it on an executed commitment (not a verbal).

Looping Ben & Sean for quick comments on precedent.

— Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up + loyalty bundle request — Adeptiva Labs

Thanks Marissa — answers below and attaching the updated pricing-proposal spreadsheet with scenario math.

1) Conversion probability: Medium-high (~65%). Buyer signals: Head of DS (Lena) committed to a pilot extension if we provide the extra credits; procurement (Tom) confirmed budget review in mid-May and said internal legal is OK to move quickly if SOW is sane.
2) NDA: we have a standard mutual NDA signed (scanned copy stored in Drive). Security: they requested SOC2 attestation and a short questionnaire — Security has reviewed and confirmed we can provide the standard SOC2 report and a scoped set of logs; no blocker.
3) Net dollar impact (converted within 90 days): $120k ARR -> NPV over 12 months ~ $102k. If they do not convert: credits used during trial approximate cost to us of ~$6k (after standard unit economics).

Recommendation: approve the credit top-up (250k tokens) and allow a loyalty discount of 10% contingent on a signed 12-month commitment of $120k ARR within 90 days. Require procurement-signed SOW and PO before applying the 10% discount to invoicing.

Attachments: pricing-proposal-ADEPT-2387.xlsx

— Rishi
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-05T09:47:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Pilot top-up + loyalty bundle request — Adeptiva Labs

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding my note to the committee. I'm supportive of a one-time top-up at this size for a strategic healthcare pilot with clear conversion gating. My conditions:

- Approve 250k token credits to be issued to the pilot account immediately.
- Approve conditional 10% loyalty discount for 12 months, only to be applied after we receive a signed SOW and PO for the $120k ARR commitment within 90 days.
- Credits expire 180 days from issuance and are non-transferable.

Please confirm legal/procurement gating and security sign-off before discount is applied. Rishi — get signatures and procurement PO; I'll sign off to Ops once we have that.

Ben Carter
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@adeptiva.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@adeptiva.com>, procurement@adeptiva.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-07T17:28:00Z
Subject: Approved: Pilot top-up + loyalty bundle — next steps

Hi Lena / Tom — great news: Ben approved the exception. Summary of what we've agreed internally and next steps:

- Approved: 250,000 token credits (issued to your trial account). Credits will expire 180 days from issuance and are non-transferable.
- Approved: 10% loyalty discount for 12 months contingent on an executed 12-month commitment at $120k ARR within 90 days of pilot close. Discount will only be applied after Redwood receives a signed SOW and PO.

What I need from you to move forward:
1) Acceptance email from procurement confirming you'll sign a SOW + PO if pilots converge (this is procurement's usual form)
2) Send the procurement PO or signed SOW to procurement@redwood.com once ready
3) Confirm invoicing contact and Billing address for the future PO

I'll have Ops issue the credits within one business day of your acceptance email. Security: we've confirmed SOC2 report is available and will share the scoped logs list if you need it.

Thanks — excited to move forward.

Best,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: adeptiva-sow-v1.pdf (SOW — draft)
